title: REQ · App renders HeaderOverlay through the header slot with round data, loading and error state
summary: App tracks round loading and error from getCurrentRound and passes them to HeaderOverlay in GameLayout's header slot.
description: Context: App.tsx fetches the round in a useEffect and swallows errors. Desired behavior: keep round, add loading (true until the fetch settles) and error (message string from the rejection, e.g. Error.message) state, remove the silent catch, and render <HeaderOverlay worldTitle round loading error /> as the GameLayout header prop. Expected result: the header shows loading, round info, or an explained failure. Why: users must understand when the round API fails.
acceptance_criteria: Given getCurrentRound is pending, when the playing view renders, then 'Loading round…' is shown
Given getCurrentRound resolves a round, when the playing view renders, then the round id and status are shown in the header
Given getCurrentRound rejects with Error('boom'), when the playing view renders, then an alert contains 'boom'
Given the header, then it is rendered inside the layout main area
technical_constraints: Use existing getCurrentRound and HeaderOverlay props (worldTitle, round, loading, error)
definition_of_done: App passes round, loading and error to HeaderOverlay; no silent catch remains
